blocks.raw: # Multi-factor authentication
blocks.text: Multi-factor authentication

blocks.raw: This page provides you with information on multi-factor authentication.
blocks.text: This page provides you with information on multi-factor authentication.

blocks.raw: Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is a security process in which users provide two or more authentication factors to verify their identity.
blocks.text: Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is a security process in which users provide two or more authentication factors to verify their identity.

blocks.raw: # Enabling MFA
blocks.text: Enabling MFA

blocks.raw: To use MFA, your brand must enable it. The configuration IS\_MFA\_ENABLED determines if MFA is active. To enable MFA, please raise a ticket with the sustenance team.
blocks.text: To use MFA, your brand must enable it. The configuration IS_MFA_ENABLED determines if MFA is active. To enable MFA, please raise a ticket with the sustenance team.

blocks.raw: # MFA flow with 2nd factor identifier
blocks.text: MFA flow with 2nd factor identifier

blocks.raw: To enable the 2nd factor identifier, use the config CONF\_AUTO\_FILL\_2ND\_FACTOR\_IDENTIFIER. See [General configurations](https://docs.capillarytech.com/reference/authentication-configurations#general-configurations)
blocks.text: To enable the 2nd factor identifier, use the config CONF_AUTO_FILL_2ND_FACTOR_IDENTIFIER. See General configurations

blocks.raw: If you enable it, the auth engine automatically populates the identifier type and value for each API in the MFA flow. This occurs for the particular session for which the token is generated from the primary flow.
blocks.text: If you enable it, the auth engine automatically populates the identifier type and value for each API in the MFA flow. This occurs for the particular session for which the token is generated from the primary flow.

blocks.text: The table below shows the four authentication combinations supported in the 2nd factor identifier.

| Authentication method in the primary flow | Authentication method in MFA flow |
| :---------------------------------------- | :-------------------------------- |
| OTP                                       | OTP                               |
| OTP                                       | Password                          |
| Password                                  | OTP                               |
| Password                                  | Password                          |
